༄༅/ /'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa'i sgrub thabs bdud dpung rnam 'joms zhes bya ba bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa'i sgrub thabs bdud dpung rnam 'joms zhes bya ba bzhugs/

na mo gu ru mañdzu gho ṣā ya/ phyi nang gsang ba'i 'chi bdag gshin rje rnams/ kun nas mthar byed 'jam dpal dpa' bo dang*/ /dbyer med rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs btud nas/ /'jigs byed dpa' gcig sgrub thabs bshad par bya/ 'dir 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa'i sgrub thabs rgyun gyi rnal 'byor du bya ba'i tshul la rgyas bsdus gnyis las/ rgyas pa ni rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs bdud las rnam rgyal bzhin lcang skya zhabs drung gis bkral ba ltar yin la/ shin tu bsdus pa ni/ paṇa chen gong ma'i gsung 'bum nas 'byung ba bzhin te/ 'dir snga ma las bsdus shing phyi ma'i dgongs pa kha bskang ba'i sgo nas cung zad rgyas par bshad pa ni/ ḍa dril dang*/ phyi nang gi mchod pa sogs rnal 'byor gyi yo byad rnams tshogs par byas te/ skyabs sems sogs spyi ltar ram/ yang na dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro/ zhes sogs sh+lo ka gcig gis skyabs 'gro sems bskyed lan gsum sngon du btang*/ rang nyid skad cig gis dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa'i skur bzhengs par gyur/ nang mchod byin rlabs rgyas pa ni/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+tā+-iḥwi kṛ tā na na hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmaḥswabhā wa shud+dho haṃ/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las/ yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs lta bu ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum pa/ de'i steng du āḥlas mi mgo'i sgyaid bu gsum gyi steng du āḥlas byung ba'i thod pa dkar po/ de'i nang gi shar du bhuṃ las byung ba'i ba lang gi sha gaus mtshan pa/ lhor aṃ las byung ba'i khyi'i sha kun mtshan pa/ nub tu dz+riṃ las byung ba'i glang po che'i sha das mtshan pa/ byang du kha las byung ba'i rta'i sha has mtshan pa/ dbus su hūṃ? las byung ba'i mi'i sha nas mtshan pa/

shar lhor laṃ las byung ba'i dri chen bis mtshan pa/ lho nub tu maṃ las byung ba'i rak+ta ras mtshan pa/ nub byang du baṃ las byung ba'i byang sems dkar po shus mtshan pa/ byang shar du taṃ las byung ba'i skar mar mes mtshan pa/ dbus su baṃ las byung ba'i dri chu mus mtshan pa/ de dag gi steng du oṃ dkar po/ āḥdamar po/ hūṃ sngon po gsum steng nas steng du brtsegs par gyur/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros/ rlung la phog /rlung g.yos/ me sbar/ thod pa'i rdzas rnams zhu zhing khol bar gyur/ yi ge gsum las 'od zer rim pa bzhin du 'phros pas/ sku rdo rje/ gsung rdo rje/ thugs rdo rje rnams bkug nas/ yi ge gsum la rim gyis thim pa rnams thod par lhung nas zhugs/ hūṃ gis kha dog dri nus kyi skyon sbyangs/ ās bdud rtsir rtogs par byas/ oṃ gyis mang por sbar zhing spel bar gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan gsum brjod nas byin gyis brlabs pa'am/ mdor bsdu na/ yi ge gsum dang ha ho hūṃḥlan gsum gyis nang mchod byin gyis brlabs te rang nyid 'jigs byed zhes pa nas 'jug pa'am/ rgyun pa'i kha ton la sngon 'gro'i mchod gtor sogs med na mi 'gal yang*/ yod na hrīḥṣ+tīḥs bsangs/ swa bhā was stong bar sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las āḥlas byung ba'i thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūṃ hūṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ zhes pa nas rol mo rnams rang bzhin bde stong rnams mchod rdzas/ byed las dbang po drug gi spyod yul du zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can bskyed par gyur/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ āḥhūṃ nas shap+ta āḥhūṃ gis bar gyis byin gyis brlabs/ gtor ma sngar bzhin brlabs te/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ zhes pa nas phyogs skyong 'khor bcas rang gnas su gshegs par gyur/ ces pa'i bar gzhan nas 'gyur ba ltar bya/ 'dir bdag bskyed kyi mchod pa sngar bzhin nam spro na 'dod yon dang bcas pa brlabs pa'am/

yang na 'og tu bya/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul 'dod na ma gtogs mi dgos la/ rdor sems kyi sgom bzlas bya ba 'dir dngos su ma gsungs kyang*/ byas na legs pas de ni rang gi spyi bo paṃ las pad+ma zhes pa nas sku gsung thugs dbyer mi phyed par gyur ces pa'i bar bcu gsum 'am ltar bya'o/ /de nas/ rang nyid 'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis par gsal ba'i thugs kar/ pad+ma dang nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis 'jig rten gyi khams mu med pa gsal bar byas/ de na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang khro bo dang*/ rig pa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba'i rdo rje 'jigs byed bla ma dang bcas pa mdun gyis nam mkhar spyan drangs/ 'od zer rang gi snying gar thim/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen gnas/ /skad cig gis ni thob 'gyur ba/ /bla ma rin chen lta bu yi/ /rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud/ /gzugs mchog mchog tu drag po che/ /dpa' bo mchog gi spyod yul can/ /gdul dka' 'dul ba'i don mdzad pa/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed la phyag 'tshal/ /zhes pas phyag bya/ rang gi snying ga'i hūṃ gi 'od zer las byung ba'i tsartsi dkar mo/ phag mo sngon mo/ dbyangs can ma dmar mo/ gau ri ljang gu phyag na mchod rdzas sna tshogs thogs pa rnams kyis mchod par gyur/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+tā+-iḥhas mchod yon dang*/ oṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa kyis zhabs bsil/ oṃ wi kṛ tā na na du ṣ+ti sa twa da ma ka gaḥg ཿ gaḥ yis dre/ oṃ gu mā ra rū pi ṇe dzaḥhūṃ phaṭa kyis me tog /oṃ hrīḥhaḥhi phaṭa kyis bdug spos/ oṃ dīp+ta lo tsa na shi kṛ tā na na ma hā a ṭ+wā ṭ+ṭa hā sa na di ni dī p+ta ya swā hās mar me/ oṃ badz+ra nai bi d+ya āḥhūṃ swā hā/ lha bshos/ oṃ badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūṃ gis rol mo rnams dbul/ de nas sdig pa rnams ni bshags par bya/ /skyes shing byung ba rnams ni bsal/ /mi byed par yang spyan sngar brjod/ /de bzhin bsod nams rjes yi rang*/

/bdag gis bder 'gro yongs su bsngo/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro/ / sems can thams cad bdag gis dgrol/ /byang chub gnas la dgod par bgyi/ /byang chub sems ni yang dag bskyed/ /yon tan rgya mtsho khyed rnams la/ / bdag gi lus 'di dbul bar bgyi/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang*/ /de sras lam gyur sbyin sogs tshul/ /sku gsum ye shes thob bya'i phyir/ / rab tu dang pos bsten par bgyi/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis bshags pa dang*/ yi rang*/ bsngo ba/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ lus 'bul ba/ lam bsten rnams bya/ de nas rigs lnga'i sdom bzung 'dod na/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' kun/ zhes pa nas sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god/ /ces pa'i bar brjod la 'dzin cing*/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan par gyur cig /ces sogs kyis tshad med bzhi bsgoms te bsod nams kyi tshogs bsag pa'o/ /de nas/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhāḥsarba dharmaḥswabhā wa shud+dho ྅haṃ/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ rang dang tshogs zhing gi lha dang de dag las gzhan pa'i chos thams cad brten nas btags pa yin pa'i phyir/ rtag chad la sogs pa'i mtha' bzhi dang bral ba'i stong pa nyid du gyur/ de ltar 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang bde ba chen por dbye mi phyed pa'i chos kyi sku'i bdag nyid du mos/ de nyid gdags gzhir byas nas nga rgyal bzhag ste bsgom pa ni ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa dang 'chi ba chos skur 'khyer ba'i lam 'khyer yin no/ /shin tu bsdu na/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis rdo rje'i sa gzhi ra ba gur bla re me ri/ dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis yongs su bskor ba'i gzhal yas khang gi nang gi dbus su yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor nag la cung zad dmar ba'i zhes bsdus te 'don pa ltar ram/ rgyas par ni/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor du ba'i mdog can zhes pa nas/

me dpung phyogs bcur 'phro bar gyur/ zhes pa'i bar gyi thun mong ba'i srung 'khor dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i srung 'khor 'dod na/ rwa ba'i dbus su zhes pa nas/ tshar gcod par gyur/ ces pa'i bar gyis bsgom/ 'di ltar na/ rang nyid gnod mdzes su gnas pa yongs su gyur pa la rdo rje sems dpa' zhes dang*/ snga ma ltar na/ rwa ba'i dbus su rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po dkar mthing dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis rang 'dra'i yul la 'khyud cing*/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis rdo rje dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis rin po che dang pad+ma 'dzin pa yongs su gyur pa las/ chos 'byung dkar po gru gsum pa/ gyen du 'greng ba 'og tu phra zhing stod yangs pa/ 'og zur nas paṃ las byung ba'i sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar/ hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje shar gyi rwa dkar/ lho'i rwa ser/ nub kyi rwa dmar/ byang gi rwa ljang*/ dbus kyi lte ba sngon pos brgyan par bsam mo/ /lte ba'i dbus su bh+ruṃ las 'khor lo bh+ruṃ gyis mtshan pa las byung ba'i rnam snang dkar po dkar mthing dmar pa'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyi rang 'dra'i yum la 'khyud cing*/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis rdo rje la gnas pa'i 'khor lo dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis rin po che dang pad+ma 'dzin pa yongs su gyur pa las gzhal yas khang gru bzhi pa sgo bzhi pa/ phyi rol nas rim pa bzhin dkar ser dmar ljang sngo ba'i rtsig pa lnga dang ldan pa/ rtsig pa'i stong na rin po che sna tshogs pas mdzes par byas pa'i rin po che'i pha gus bskor ba'i gzhal yas khang gi nang du/ rdo rje'i phreng bas zlum por bskor ba la brten pa'i ka ba brgyad kyis btegs pa'i rdo rje'i gdung bzhis mdzes par thub pa/ rtse mo rdo rje nor bu rin po che'i tog gis mdzes pa'i nang gi shar dkar lho ser nub dmar byang ljang dbus sngo ba/ pha gu'i steng na gser gyi ka rags bzhi'i phyi ngos su chu srin gyi kha nas 'phyang ba'i rin po che'i dra ba dang dra ba phyed pa la dril bu dang rnga yab la sogs pas brgyan pa/

de'i phyir ngos su bya 'dab las 'phyang ba'i rin po che'i shar bu/ de'i steng du mda' yab pad+ma 'dab ma phyed pa'i dbyibs can la/ ba dan dang rgyal mtshan la sogs pas mdzes par byas pa/ rtsig pa'i mtha' nas 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar pos/ 'gram stegs kyi rnam par bskor ba la/ lha mo mchod rdzas thogs pa rnams 'khod nas mchod pa byed pa/ sgo dang sgo 'khyud kyi phyi'i mtshams dang*/ 'og gi phyi nang gi grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rje rin chen gyis spras pa/ sgo bzhi so so'i mdun du ka ba bzhi bzhis bteg pa'i rta bab snam bu bcu gcig dang ldan pa'i steng du chos kyi 'khor lo/ / de'i g.yas g.yon du ri dwags pho mo dang bcas pa/ rdo rje'i rwa ba me ri dang bcas pa'i phyi rol du/ gtum drag la sogs pa'i dur khrod brgyad na/ nā ga ge sar gyi shing ngam shi ri ṣa la sogs pa'i shing brgyad/ de'i rtsa bar brgya byin la sogs pa'i phyogs skyong brgyad/ rtse mor rdzu 'phrul chen po ba glang po che'i gdong pa can la sogs pa'i zhing skyong brgyad/ thugs rje'i chu brgyad/ de la gnas pa'i nor rgyas la sogs pa'i klu brgyad/ de dag gi steng gi nam mkha' la sgrogs pa la sogs pa'i sprin brgyad/ ye shes kyi me brgyad/ mchod rten brgyad/ gzhan yang keng rus dang*/ gsal shing gis phug pa'i ro dang*/ shing la dpyangs pa dang*/ skyes bu za ba dang*/ mtshon gyis phug pa la sogs pa dang*/ bya rog dang bya rgod dang khyi dang ce spyang dang*/ seng ge dang stag la sogs pa dang*/ ca co sgrog pa'i ro langs dang*/ gnod sbyin dang srin po la sogs pa rnams kyis 'jigs su rung ba/ grub pa dang rig pa 'dzin pa dang dam tshig spyod pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ bcom ldan 'das la rtse gcig tu blta ba/ gcer bu skra bshig pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ cang te'u dang thod pa dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa thod pas spyi bor brgyan pa/ rgod cing dur khrod du 'jug pa sogs kyis/

shin tu ngo mtshar bar byed pa'i dur khrod rnams kyis bskor ba'i rab bsam pa ni rten bskyed pa'o/ /gzhal yas khang gi dbus su yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor nag la cung zad dmar ba'i mdog can gyi steng du a yig dang po las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su chu las chu bur gyi tshul du hrīḥser po las byung ba'i ral gri'i dbus su hrīs mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs/ thim pa yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa sku mdog ser po/ yid tsam khros pa phyag g.yas ral gri 'phyang zhing*/ g.yon gyis glegs bam thugs kar bsnams pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ mtshan so gnyis dang dpe byad brgyad cus brgyan pa/ ral pa'i zur phud lnga dang ldan zhing*/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ de ltar bsgom pa ni bar do longs skur 'khyer ba'i rnal 'byor ro/ /de'i thugs kar āḥlas byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i 'od kyis phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i rnam snang la sogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang*/ rdo rje rnon po la sogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ rdo rje lcags kyu la sogs pa'i khro bo dang*/ sems ma rdo rje ma la sogs pa'i rig pa rnams spyan drangs te/ 'jam dpal dang bcas pa nyi ma la zhugs pas 'od zer gyis dpag tshad stong phrag brgyar khyab pa'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor du gyur/ de'i steng du hūṃ yig mthing ga 'od zer lnga dang ldan pa las 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang khro bo dang rig pa'i tshogs rnams spyan drangs te hūṃ la zhugs pa las khro bo'i rdo rje kha dog nag po rtse dgu pa rwa shin tu gdengs pa 'od zer lnga dang ldan pa/ lte ba la hūṃ yig gis mtshan pa/ de las rdo rje phra mo'i gzugs spros pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang khro bo dang rig pa'i tshogs rnams spros te/

nam mkha'i khams thams cad til gyi gang bu bzhin du gang ba/ nyi ma la gnas pas sems can rnams smin par byas nas/ rdo rje 'jigs byed thob par byas pa dang lhan cig tu 'dus nas rdo rje la thim par gyur/ zla dang de'i steng gi nyi ma rdo rje hūṃ dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba dang nyi ma'i steng du/ rang nyid 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po/ sku mdog mthing nag zhal dgu phyag so bzhi zhabs bcu drug pa g.yas bskums shing g.yon brkyangs pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ khams gsum po za bar nus pa/ ha ha zhes sgrog cing ljags 'gril pa/ mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa khro gnyer can/ khro gnyer gyi 'gram du smin ma dang spyan 'jigs pa'i dus ltar 'bar ba/ skra kham ser gyen du brdzes pa/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha la sdigs mdzub byed pa/ 'jigs pa rnams kyang 'jigs par mdzad pa/ phaiṃ ka ra'i sgra chen po 'brug ltar sgrog pa/ mi'i khrag dang zhag dang rkang dang tshil bu za ba/ 'jigs su rung ba'i thod pa skam po lngas thod byas shing*/ mgo bo rlon pa lnga bcu'i thod pa'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ sprul nag po mchod phyir thogs dang mi rus kyi 'khor lo dang*/ rna cha la sogs pa rus pa'i rgyan rnams kyis brgyan pa/ gsus pa che ba gcer bu'i gzugs can/ mtshan ma gyen du 'greng ba/ smin ma dang rdzi ma dang sma ra dang ba spu rnams dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar zhing*/ rtsa zhal nag po ma he'i gdong can shin tu khros pa rā rnon po can/ de'i steng ma rwa gnyis kyi dbus kyi zhal dmar po rab tu 'jigs pa zhal nas khrag 'dzag pa/ de'i steng du 'jam dpal gyi zhal ser po yed tsam khros pa/ gzhon nu'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ spyi bor ral pa lnga dang ldan pa/ rwa'i rtsa ba'i g.yas kyi zhal dang po sngon po/

de'i g.yas zhal dmar po/ g.yon zhal ser po/ rwa'i rtsa ba'i g.yon gyi zhal dang po dkar po/ de'i g.yas zhal dud ka /g.yon zhal nag po/ zhal rnams shin tu khros pa/ zhal dgu po thams cad kyang spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa'o/ /phyag g.yas g.yon gyi dang po gnyis kyis glang po che'i pags pa rlon pa mgo g.yas dang spu phyir bstan te lag pa dang rkang pa'i lpags pa g.yon pa nas brkyangs te 'dzin pa/ lhag ma g.yas kyi dang po na gri gug /gnyis pa na bhi dhī pā la/ gsum pa nag tu na shing*/ bzhi pa na chu gri/ lnga pa na ka ṇa ya/ drug pa na dgra ste/ bdun pa na mdung*/ brgyad pa na mda'/ dgu pa na lcags kyu/ bcu pa na dbyug tho/ bcu gcig pa na kha ṭ+waṃ ga / bcu gnyis pa na 'khor lo/ bcu gsum par rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ bcu bzhi pa na rdo rje tho ba/ bco lnga pa na ral gri/ bcu drug pa na cang te'u bsnams shing*/ lhag ma g.yon gyi dang po na khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa/ gnyis pa na tshangs pa'i mgo bo/ gsum pa na phub/ bzhi pa na rkang pa/ lnga pa na zhags pa/ drug pa na gzhu/ bdun pa na rgyu ma/ brgyad pa na dril bu/ dgu pa na lag pa/ bcu pa dur khrod kyi ras/ bcu gcig pa na skyes bu gsal shing la btsugs pa/ bcu gnyis pa me thab/ bcu gsum pa na thod tshal/ bcu bzhi pa na sdigs mdzub/ bco lnga pa na 'phan rtse gsum pa/ bcu drug pa na rlung ras bsnams pa'o/ /zhabs g.yas kyi dang pos mi/ gnyis pas ma he/ gsum pas glang*/ bzhi pas bong bu/ lnga pas rnga mong*/ drug pas khyi/ bdun pas lug /brgyad pa wa dang*/ g.yon gyi dang pos bya rgod/ gnyis pas 'ug pa/ gsum pas bya rog /bzhi pas ne tso/ lnga pas khra/ drug pas bya chen po/ bdun pas khyim bya/ brgyad pas bzhad mnan pa/ tshangs pa dang dbang po dang khyab 'jug dang drag po dang gzhon nu gdong drug dang log 'dren dang zla ba dang nyi ma rnams kha sbub tu byas te/ zhabs 'og tu mnan nas me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na bzhugs pa/

'di ni skye ba sprul skur 'khyer ba'i rnal 'byor ro/ /rje'i sgrub thabs las skabs 'dir skye mched byin brlab bya bar bshad pa ltar ram/ yang na 'di ltar yang rung ste/ rang nyid dam tshig sems dpa'i thugs kar zla gdan la ye shes sems dpa' 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa sku mdog ser po/ yid tsam khros pa phyag g.yas ral gri 'phyar zhing g.yon gyis glegs bam thugs kar bsnams pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ mtshan so gnyis dang dpe byad brgyad cus brgyan pa/ ral pa'i zur phud lnga dang ldan zhing*/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ de'i thugs kar āḥlas byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su/ ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' hūṃ yig mthing ga 'od zer lnga 'phro ba/ rang gi mig gnyis su k+ṣiṃ/ rna ba gnyis su dz+riṃ/ snar khaṃ/ lce'i rtsa bar raṃ/ dpral bar kaṃ /lte bar saṃ/ spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ gis mtshan par gyur/ yang na/ mig gnyis su sa snying gi rang bzhin k+ṣiṃ k+ṣiṃ dkar po sogs gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar bya'o/ /rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ hrīḥṣ+tā+-is phyir 'brang gi bgegs bsgrad/ hrīḥṣ+tā+-iḥha sogs kyis mchod/ 'di nas dbang lha bstim pa'i bar gtso bo gcig pu'i khyad ma gtogs bcu gsum ma ltar ram/ bsdu na/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥslar yang thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ khyed rnams kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de rnams kyis ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thogs nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣī ka ta sa ma ya shrī āḥhūṃ zhes dbang bskur lus gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma spyi gtsug tu gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las/

mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan cing*/ dbang gi lha rnams kyang rang nyid la thim par gyur/ de nas oṃ hrīḥṣ+tā+-iḥta sogs sam/ oṃ ya mān+ta ka sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod la/ nang mchod rgyas bsdus ci rigs skabs dang sbyar nas 'bul/ bstod pa yang spro na 'jam dpal gser mdog ma dang*/ bsdu na/ gnyis med thun mong ma yin khyab pa'i sku/ /kun la snyoms mdzad rgyal ba kun gyi yab/ /chos kyi dbyings gyur rgyal ba kun gyi yum/ /ye shes sems dpa' rgyal ba kun gyi sras/ /phyag 'tshal 'jam dpal dpal gyur rdzogs pa khyod/ /chos kyi sku la byams sdang mi mnga' yang*/ /srid gsum gdug pa ma lus 'dul ba'i phyir/ /thugs rje'i thabs kyis khro rgyal skur bstan pa/ /'jigs byed gshin rje gshed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos po khyod/ / sangs rgyas thams cad gcig bsdus pa/ /sangs rgyas kun mchog gtso bo'i gtso/ /dkyil 'khor gtso la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /de las kyang bsdu na/ gzugs mchog mchog tu drag po che/ /zhes sogs sh+lo ka gcig bya/ skabs 'dir bskyed pa'i rim pa'i rnal 'byor la rtse gcig tu brtson par byas nas/ bskyed rim phra rags la rtse gcig tu mnyam par 'jog /bsgoms pas skyo na/ de ltar zhal dgu ni nas/ mtshan ma gyen du 'greng ba ni bde ba chen po rgyas pa nas/ go bar byed pa'o/ /zhes dag pa dran par bya/ bsdu na ma byas kyang chog /de nas bgrang 'phreng 'jigs byed dpa' gcig tu bskyed/ ye shes pa dgug gzhug /mchod bstod bzlas pa cung zad byas/ bcom ldan 'das zhu ba las byung ba'i khrag 'dzag pa'i mgo 'phreng du bsams te zhi khro sbrags bsgrub kyi man ngag zhal nas 'byung ba ltar du/ bzlas pa'i skyon dang bral bar/ a ra pa tsa na dang*/ oṃ ya ma rā dzā sa do me ya/ ya me do ru/ ṇa yo da ya/ ya da yo ni ra ya k+ṣe ya/ ya k+ṣe yats+tsha ni rā ma ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/

zhes pa rtsa sngags dang*/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+tā+-iḥwi kṛ tā na na hūṃ phaṭa/ ces las sngags dang*/ oṃ ya mān+ta ka hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa snying po ste/ sngags gsum po ci rigs pa dmigs pa dang bcas bzla/ bsnyen pa'i grangs ni/ gsum ka'am hrīḥṣ+tā+-i ya sum 'bum mam 'bum phrag gcig ye shes 'bebs sngags kha skong sbyin sreg dang bcas pa bya'o/ /rang yi dam du gsal pa'i thugs ka'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'i mtha' skor du sngags 'phreng gsum po yi ge 'bar ba'i gzugs su yod pa las/ 'od zer 'phros rang gzhan gyi sdig sgrib nad gdon thams cad tshar bcad cing sems can gyi don byas/ sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi mthu stobs byin rlabs thams cad 'od zer sna lnga'i rnam par bkug /snying ga'i sngags 'phreng la thim par bsams te/ bzlas pa'i mjug tu gshin rje gshed kyi yig brgyas brtan par byas la/ mchod bstod mdor bsdus bya/ gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod na/ nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlab/ bskyed tshul rgyas pa gzhan du shes la/ bsdu na spyan drangs te 'bul ba ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa'i ye shes pa mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ ya mān+ta ka'i mjug tu ba liṃ ta sogs btags pa lnga'am gsum gyis gtor ma phul te mchod bstod mdor bsdus bya/ badz+ra muḥye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par gyur par bsam mo/ /mjug tu nye bar bsdus te 'od gsal gyi ngang las/ slar yang dpa' bo gcig pa'i skur langs te/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /ces sogs bsngo smon rnam par dag pas rgyas 'debs shing*/ thun 'tshams su lha'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pa'i ngang nas/ nyal ba dang*/ ldang ba dang*/ khrus dang*/ kha zas kyi rnal 'byor sogs rgyud dang grub chen gyi gzhung nas 'byung ba ltar nyams su blangs te/ dal 'byor thob pa don dang ldan par bya'o/ /smras pa/

gang zhig bsten pas 'chi bdag bdud sde'i dpung*/ /ma lus mthar byed bla ma gshin rje'i gshed/ /de nyid sgrub par byed pa'i rnal 'byor mchog /'khyer bde kun phan rin chen 'phreng ba spel/ /tshul 'dir 'bad las byung ba'i rnam dkar dge /ji snyed mchis pa des kyang bdag gzhan kun/ /byang chub bar du 'jam dpal zhi khro yis/ /'bral med dgyes bzhin rjes su 'dzin gyur cig /ces 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa'i sgrub thabs rin chen 'phreng ba zhes bya ba 'di ni/ shākya'i dge slong rab 'byams smra ba grags pa bshad sgrub kyis dad pas kun nas bslangs te rje nyid kyi man ngag bzhin co ne dgon nyid du legs par sbyar ba'o/ /bkra shis// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa'i sgrub thabs bdud dpung rnam 'joms zhes bya ba bzhugs/ -PAGE 56--PAGE 55--PAGE 43-
